style.styleTitle: Personalised Pet Memorial Christmas Tree Ornament by Jonnys Sister
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Designed and personalised by Jonny's Sister in their Somerset studios, this pet memorial Christmas tree ornament is a lovely way to remember your faithful friend. </p><p>It is made of MDF wood and can be customised with your pet's name and a message creating a lasting memorial that can be used year after year This hanging decoration comes complete with a tartan ribbon and your choice of name and message printed. </p><p>Dimensions: 8cm diameter.</p>
